claim_scope.network_class: ported strict binary rooted tree-child/strong-tail level-2 primitive cores
claim_scope.model: independent-lineage NMSC with positive finite rates and inheritance probabilities
claim_scope.observation: total marked first-merger/survival laws plus route-exclusive labelled anchor cells
claim_scope.parameter_domain: positive rational durations and rates; inheritance weights strictly between zero and one
claim_scope.quantifier: exact bounded falsification on all four theta0/theta1 exposure-loss minimum repairs
claim_scope.target: complete exposed-V record, residual Q8 carrier, and joint V-then-X reattachment

conventions.segment_ids: zero-based positions in each primitive core's arcs array
conventions.physical_q_order: lexicographic order of exact incoming V incidence tuples (tail, head, edge key, segment, edge role)
conventions.child_corridor_weight: the X-parent route descending from V; the complementary physical route has weight one minus this value
